subject.title: fix: preserve discovered context limits over static metadata

question: Should verified provider discovery override bundled static context metadata across all providers, with bundled rows serving only as missing-key fallback?
rationale: The documented GitHub Copilot behavior supports this precedence, but the helper is shared and changes context and compaction budgets for every provider discovery implementation rather than only Copilot.

options.title: Adopt provider-wide live-first precedence
options.body: Confirm discovered provider metadata is authoritative, refresh the branch, and merge after the focused and required checks pass on the exact head.

options.title: Narrow the precedence change
options.body: Limit the behavior to provider sources explicitly designated authoritative if maintainers do not want every discovery implementation to override bundled safety metadata.

recommendation.title: Adopt provider-wide live-first precedence
recommendation.body: Confirm discovered provider metadata is authoritative, refresh the branch, and merge after the focused and required checks pass on the exact head.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged history connects this person to Copilot live-catalog policy, metadata cleanup, and review of the provider behavior this shared cache serves.
